help.general: The purpose of this tool is to make work with property matters easier.
help.listView:
When you click in the map, the services are searched. The search looks at the property you clicked on and checks which layers affect the property.

The results are shown in a list. If you click close to a property boundary, you may get results for several properties. If there are several options, make sure to note which property in the list you chose to review against.
help.mainButton:
At the top of the tool there is a button, the main button. With it you can activate a mode that lets you click in the map to select a property of interest.

After a click, this button changes to a clear button. Click it to reset the tool and select another property.
help.quickLayers: Right below the main button you'll find three quick buttons. They show the Buildings, Property information and Detail plans layers.
